mcq.q: Which word has the long vowel /ɔː/?
mcq.explanation: 'Door' has /ɔː/; the others have the short /ʌ/.

mcq.q: Which word has the short vowel /ʌ/?
Which word begins with the cluster 'sw'?
Which word begins with the cluster 'br'?
Which word begins with the cluster 'pr'?
Which word begins with the cluster 'cl'?
Which word begins with the cluster 'gr'?
Which is a yes/no question?
mcq.explanation: It starts with a helping verb and can be answered yes or no.

mcq.q: What does it mean to speak with expression?
options: To speak in a whisper only
To use the voice to show meaning and feeling
mcq.explanation: Expression means changing loudness, stress and pitch to show feeling.

mcq.q: What is hesitation in speaking?
Which of these helps you speak fluently?
options: Practising what you want to say

mcq.q: Which answer suits 'Do you sweep every day?'
mcq.explanation: A yes/no question needs a yes or no answer.

mcq.q: What is a proverb?
options: A short well-known saying that gives advice or a truth

mcq.q: What does 'Many hands make light work' mean?
options: A job is easier when many people help

mcq.q: What does 'A stitch in time saves nine' mean?
options: Nine stitches are better than one
Fixing a small problem early prevents a bigger one

mcq.q: What does 'Prevention is better than cure' mean?
options: It is better to stop a problem than to solve it later

mcq.q: What is a chorus in a song?
options: The part repeated after each verse

mcq.q: What is rhythm?
mcq.explanation: Rhythm is the pattern of beats.

mcq.q: Which words rhyme?
mcq.explanation: 'Green' and 'clean' end with the same sound.

mcq.q: Which syllable is stressed in 'com-POUND'?
In 'The Clean-Up Day', which proverb did Kamau use about fixing the hole in the fence?
options: A stitch in time saves nine
mcq.explanation: He wanted to fix the small hole before it got worse.

mcq.q: Which is a factual question about the passage?
options: What kind of person is Kamau?
What job did Class Six do?
Why do you think the head teacher smiled?
mcq.explanation: The answer is stated in the text.

mcq.q: Which situation fits 'Little by little fills the measure'?
options: Getting a big prize at once
Picking up a little rubbish every day until the compound is clean

mcq.q: How should you read a poem with rhythm?
options: Tap the beat and stress the strong syllables
Read as fast as you can
mcq.explanation: Follow the beat with your voice.

mcq.q: Which sentence is in the present perfect?
What is the past participle of 'eat'?
What is the past participle of 'write'?
What is the past participle of 'go'?
Which sentence uses the past perfect?
options: I had finished before he came.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the correct form of the verb 'go' with the present perfect?
options: They have went to the river.
They have gone to the river.
They has gone to the river.
They have go to the river.
mcq.explanation: The participle of go is gone.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the correct participle of 'eat'?
Which time word often goes with the present perfect?
mcq.explanation: 'Already' fits the present perfect; finished-time words do not.

mcq.q: When I arrived, the bus had left. Which happened first?
mcq.explanation: The past perfect shows the earlier action.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the right tense with the time word 'yesterday'?
options: I had seen him yesterday now.
mcq.explanation: Use the simple past with a finished time such as yesterday.

mcq.q: Which is the past participle of 'break'?
Which is the negative of 'I have eaten'?
What must a diary entry begin with?
In which person is a diary usually written?
mcq.explanation: A diary is about what I did and felt.

mcq.q: Which sentence describes a feeling?
options: I felt proud of our work.

mcq.q: Which tense do we usually use for earlier events in a diary?
mcq.explanation: Events that already happened use the past tense.

mcq.q: What is a diary?
options: A personal record of what happens to you each day
mcq.explanation: A diary records events and feelings.

mcq.q: Which is a good way to start a diary entry sentence?
mcq.explanation: Diary sentences often start with 'Today I ...'.

mcq.q: What is a good way to end a diary entry?
options: With a plan for tomorrow or a short sign-off
mcq.explanation: Diaries often end with plans or 'Goodnight'.

mcq.q: Which is a sentence in the future tense about tomorrow?
options: Tomorrow I will visit my grandmother.

mcq.q: How is a diary different from a letter?
options: A diary always has an address
A diary is written for yourself and is not sent
A diary is always sent by post
mcq.explanation: A letter is sent to another person.

mcq.q: Which word can help you show the order of events in a diary?

short.q: Write two words for each cluster: (a) br (b) gr.
short.answer: (a) bring, broom (or bread, brush) (b) green, grass (or grow, ground)

short.q: Explain what it means to speak with expression.
short.answer: It means using the voice to show meaning and feeling by changing loudness, stress and pitch.
short.working: 1 mark for using the voice and 1 for showing feeling or meaning.

short.q: Write three yes/no questions about keeping the compound clean.
short.answer: For example: Do you sweep the compound? Is the bin covered? Can we plant a tree?

short.q: Write a short speech of four sentences about protecting a river.
short.answer: A greeting, two points such as not throwing rubbish in the river and planting trees on its bank, and a closing.

short.q: Explain the proverb 'A stitch in time saves nine'.
short.answer: Fixing a small problem early stops it becoming a bigger problem that takes more work.
short.working: 1 mark for fixing early and 1 for avoiding bigger work.

short.q: Give a situation in which 'Prevention is better than cure' applies.
short.answer: Washing hands before eating prevents illness, which is better than getting sick and needing medicine.
short.working: 1 mark for a situation and 1 for linking it to the proverb.

short.q: What kind of person is Kamau in 'The Clean-Up Day'? Give a reason from the text.
short.answer: Observant and responsible: he noticed a hole in the fence and said it should be fixed at once.
short.working: 1 mark for each quality and 1 for evidence.

short.q: Mark the words you would stress in: 'We must keep our compound clean.'
short.answer: We must KEEP our COMpound CLEAN. (Important words: keep, compound, clean.)

short.q: Write the past participle of: write, see, take.
Rewrite using the past perfect: 'The bus left. Then I arrived.'
short.answer: The bus had left before I arrived. (Or: When I arrived, the bus had left.)
short.working: 1 mark for 'had left' and 1 for the linking word.

short.q: Explain the difference between 'I have eaten' and 'I had eaten when he came.'
short.answer: 'I have eaten' says the eating is finished and it matters now. 'I had eaten when he came' says I finished eating before he came, in the past.
short.working: 1 mark for each meaning and 1 for the time link.

short.q: Write four sentences about your morning: two with have or has and two with had.
short.answer: For example: I have brushed my teeth. She has swept the floor. We had eaten before we left. He had washed before school.

short.q: List three parts of a diary entry.
short.answer: Day and date; greeting (Dear Diary); body (events and feelings); sign-off. Any three.

short.q: Write two reasons why people keep diaries.
short.answer: To remember events; to practise writing; to record feelings.

short.q: Rewrite in the past tense: 'Today we sweep the compound and plant a tree.'
short.answer: Today we swept the compound and planted a tree.
short.working: 1 mark for swept and 1 for planted.

short.q: Write a diary entry of about 60 words about a day at school. Include the date, feelings and a plan for tomorrow.
short.answer: An entry in the first person with a date, events in order, feelings, a plan and a sign-off.
short.working: 1 mark for the date, 1 for events in order, 1 for feelings, 1 for a plan, 1 for correct tense and punctuation.
